answer: Because the network salts each queue with honeypot tasks whose answers are known bad, an agent that attests one loses weight and burns its recruiter's bond, so trust has to attach to a completed task rather than a name. A 500-clone farm must survive 500 independent trap draws, keep every delivery on the atlas, and rebuild the ivory of a clean record after any single bad recruit, which costs more than the grove of rewards it can reach.
